overall_summary: After deduplicating 47 unique videos, performance is polarized. High-concept 'What If You Fell Into...' extreme space survival scenarios and counter-intuitive planetary physics dominate the channel's top performers (consistently hitting 800–1,050+ views and 20–38 likes with 19–21s runtimes). Conversely, redundant psychology trivia ('fake memories', 'earworms') and recycled basic space facts ('space is silent', 'stars older than the universe') suffer severe viewer fatigue, languishing under 100 views.

winning_patterns.pattern: First-Person Extreme Survival Scenario ('What If You Fell Into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,029 views, 38 likes), 'What If You Fell Into the Darkest Planet?' (823 views, 15 likes), and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views, 18 likes) represent the highest tier of engagement and watch velocity.
winning_patterns.action: Pair immediate visceral peril with exotic astrophysical entities, focusing on step-by-step physical breakdown of the human body.

winning_patterns.pattern: Paradoxical Extreme Physics Hook with Optimal Duration (19-21s)
winning_patterns.evidence: 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' generated 981 views in 15 days; 'The Planet Darker Than Coal' reached 1,028 views and 36 likes. Both utilize tight ~20-second pacing that maximizes completion rate.
winning_patterns.action: Maintain short runtimes (19–21 seconds) and open directly on a brain-breaking scientific contrast without intro fluff.

weak_patterns.evidence: Multiple iterations of 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' flatlined at 5, 10, and 53 views; 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You' capped at 38 views.
weak_patterns.action: Shelve low-stakes cognitive bias trivia; pivot psychological concepts into visceral physiological horror or high-stakes survival mysteries.

weak_patterns.evidence: Repeated uploads of 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' collapsed down to 34 views; 'This Star Is Older Than the Universe!' stalled at 11 views.
weak_patterns.action: Enforce strict deduplication; reject generalized planetary trivia in favor of named, extreme, high-threat celestial anomalies.
